verdict.what_is_wrong: The trace does not support the proposed per-container memory-cap diagnosis: the deciding slices had zero memcg reclaim. It does show a brief host-level reclaim signal—47 kswapd events in the 21:52:00–21:52:10 slice—during a broad workload surge, so the closest supported fault is transient host memory pressure; the trace does not establish how severe it was or which workload caused it.
